requirements.text: As a website visitor, I want to check my credit score via an integrated tool or estimator on the website, so that I can engage with the site and consider taking action to repair my credit.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder confirmed the credit score check feature is needed for lead generation, and the analyst's summary includes this as a user story.

requirements.text: As a website visitor, I want to provide explicit consent before my personal data (name, phone, credit issues, service interests) is collected and used for lead generation, so that I am aware of and agree to the data processing.
requirements.rationale: The transcript discusses collecting sensitive personal data (credit issues, bankruptcies) and contact details for lead generation, which implies a need for a consent mechanism to comply with privacy regulations like GDPR or CCPA.

requirements.text: The lead capture form must include a privacy notice explaining how collected data (e.g., credit issues, phone number) will be used and stored.
requirements.rationale: Collecting sensitive data like credit history and bankruptcies requires a privacy notice to meet transparency obligations under data protection laws.

requirements.text: Lead data (name, phone, credit issues, service interests) must be stored and transmitted securely (e.g., encrypted at rest and in transit).
requirements.rationale: The form collects personal and financial-related data (credit issues, bankruptcies) that requires encryption to prevent data breaches and comply with security standards.

requirements.text: As a system administrator, I want access to lead data (including credit issues and personal contact details) to be restricted to authorized staff only (e.g., the lead recipient), so that sensitive information is not exposed to unauthorized personnel.
requirements.rationale: The transcript specifies that Spk 1 receives the lead data, implying a need for access controls to ensure only authorized team members can view sensitive credit and contact information.

requirements.text: The system must maintain an audit log of all access and modifications to lead data (including credit issues and personal details).
requirements.rationale: Handling sensitive financial-related data (credit issues, bankruptcies) requires an audit trail to comply with regulatory requirements and enable breach investigations.

requirements.text: As a website visitor, I want to have the ability to request deletion of my submitted personal data (e.g., name, phone, credit issues) after submission, so that I can exercise my data privacy rights under applicable laws.
requirements.rationale: Collecting sensitive personal data like credit issues and bankruptcies implies the need for data subject rights (e.g., right to erasure) to comply with privacy regulations.

requirements.text: The credit score estimator should be presented as a simple, engaging tool (e.g., a demo or simplified estimator) rather than a technical real-score integration.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder prioritizes lead generation over technical accuracy, and the analyst's suggestion of a 'simplified estimator or demo interface' aligns with an ease-of-use, engagement-focused interaction style.

requirements.text: As a company representative, I want to receive the submitted lead data (including contact details, selected credit issues, and selected services) so that I can tailor follow-up and generate leads.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder repeatedly emphasized needing the data to tailor follow-up and generate leads, implying the system must deliver this data to them.

requirements.text: As a system, I want to store lead information including contact details (phone number required, email optional) and selected credit issues and services, so that the company can follow up with tailored offers.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly stated the need for phone number, email, credit issues, and services in the lead capture form.

requirements.text: As a potential client, I want to submit my contact details (including mandatory phone number and optional email) and select my specific credit issues and services of interest through an online form, so that the company can receive actionable lead data.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly stated they need more than just names and emails, and specified the mandatory fields and selection options for credit issues and services.

requirements.text: As a website visitor, I want to learn about the available credit repair services (e.g., dispute assistance, credit monitoring, debt validation) on the website, so that I can understand how the company can help me.
requirements.rationale: The analyst's summary includes this as a user story, and it aligns with the stakeholder's need to generate leads through service awareness.

requirements.text: As a potential client, I want to receive an immediate confirmation message after submitting my information, so that I know my submission was successful.
requirements.rationale: Spk 0 repeatedly asks about post-submission behavior (confirmation message, email, thank-you page), indicating a need that is not captured in the existing user stories.

requirements.text: As a potential client, I want to receive an automated email after submitting my information, so that I have a record of my submission and next steps.
requirements.rationale: Spk 0 explicitly asks about an automated email as a follow-up action, which is a standard requirement for lead management.

requirements.text: As a potential client, I want to be redirected to a thank-you page with next steps after submitting my information, so that I know what to expect next.
requirements.rationale: Spk 0 explicitly asks about a thank-you page with next steps, indicating a need for clear post-submission guidance.

requirements.text: As a company representative, I want submitted lead information to be sent to me or my team in a specific format (e.g., email notification, entry into a spreadsheet or CRM), so that we can efficiently process and follow up on leads.
requirements.rationale: Spk 0 explicitly asks about the format for delivering lead information to the team, which is a critical internal requirement for lead management.
